news.title: GitLab jumps on Q2 beat, raised guidance
news.summary: GitLab (GTLB) reported Q2 non-GAAP EPS of 24c vs. 18c expected on revenue of $286.25M vs. $273.12M expected, and raised full-year adjusted EPS and revenue guidance. Shares were up roughly 15-25% through the morning with several sell-side price-target increases following the print.

news.title: Dell rallies on FQ2 beat, raised full-year outlook
news.summary: Dell (DELL) beat on both adjusted EPS and revenue for its fiscal Q2 and raised full-year guidance. Shares were up roughly 5-9% through the morning, with elevated options volume on the name.

news.title: MongoDB slides despite beating estimates
news.summary: MongoDB (MDB) beat Q2 estimates on both earnings and revenue, but shares fell 11-14% after a couple of sell-side price-target cuts -- a guidance-driven pullback rather than a miss on the quarter itself.

news.title: Credo Technology drops on latest quarterly report
news.summary: Credo Technology (CRDO) fell 9-17% through the morning following its Q1 earnings report, joining today's list of earnings-driven movers.

news.title: Iran conflict escalates: tankers hit, oil and yields extend higher
news.summary: U.S. Central Command struck Iranian military targets after Iran's Revolutionary Guard attempted attacks on Gulf shipping, and Iran launched retaliatory strikes toward U.S. bases in the region. Since then, two oil tankers (one Saudi-flagged, one South Korean-owned) were reportedly hit by projectiles as the exchange continued. Oil extended its gains (WTI +5.2% since Tuesday, Brent near $95) and Treasury yields pushed to their highest levels in roughly a year, adding a layer of macro risk to the session.

news.title: ADP employment, factory orders, and the Fed Beige Book due today
news.summary: Wednesday's economic calendar includes the ADP August private-payrolls report, July factory orders, and the Federal Reserve's Beige Book. None are policy decisions on their own, but they're today's scheduled data points ahead of Friday's nonfarm payrolls.

news.title: Bitcoin and Ether soften into the session, proxy basket tracking spot
news.summary: BTC and ETH both traded lower through Wednesday's morning session, with SOL down further; the crypto-proxy equity basket (MSTR, COIN, CRCL, and others) has been moving roughly in line with spot rather than diverging, unlike Tuesday evening's gap.
